title: Build the launch-time availability checks and the refusal path
statement: At every launch resolve the recorded selection, verify an authentication source is configured, verify the package and required tools loaded, verify a matching compatibility record exists, and refuse the run with a specific reason when any check fails.
notes: ⚠️ DEPENDS ON TSK-0042, ADDED 2026-09-22 (B1). The fourth launch check needs the full compatibility key, including the preflight contract digest, and only TSK-0042 (on TSK-0041's canary contract) computes it and writes the record. Without it no launch can show a matching record. ⚠️ THE EXPECTED KEY IS COMPUTED FROM THE CURRENT RUNTIME INPUTS at launch, never read back from the stored record, or the comparison compares the record with itself. ⚠️ A DIFFERENT-MODEL ONE-RUN OVERRIDE NEEDS A ROUTE TO MATCHING COMPATIBILITY PROOF, or the override offered as a remedy can never start a run. ⚠️ IN PROGRESS: lib/launch-checks.mjs holds the checks as component work (EVD-0129). Since EVD-0131 its key is computed from the resolved model and effective endpoint, and a one-run override has an approved per-run proof. What remains is wiring the checks into bin/start-kiln.mjs with a canary runner.
